description: This file defines the KafkaUtils object for constructing Kafka streams and RDDs within Apache Spark Streaming, including methods for creating RDDs and DStreams from Kafka data, with support for both Scala and Java APIs.

classes.name: KafkaUtils
classes.description: Object providing utility methods for creating Kafka streams and RDDs in Spark Streaming.

methods.name: createRDD
methods.description: Creates an RDD from Kafka data with specified offsets and location strategy (Scala and Java versions).

methods.name: createDirectStream
methods.description: Creates a direct Kafka input stream for Spark Streaming (Scala and Java versions).

methods.name: fixKafkaParams
methods.description: Adjusts Kafka parameters to prevent issues on executors, such as disabling auto-commit and setting group IDs.
